title: Garrison / Database
description: Database statements and transactions: latency by operation and table, errors, connections, write lock waits, retries, retention, request history capture, and archives.

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.description: Garrison node: the server pod or container name, or the worker node name.

list.name: window
list.label: Average over
list.description: Window for rates, averages, and percentiles. Runs are infrequent, so short windows leave gaps.

panels.title: Statements per second
panels.description: Statements and transactions per second over the averaging window.

targets.expr: sum(rate(garrison_db_operation_duration_seconds_count{provider=~"$provider", table=~"$table", node=~"$node"}[$window])) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Statement p95
panels.description: 95th percentile statement duration.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(garrison_db_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{provider=~"$provider", table=~"$table", node=~"$node", operation!="transaction"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Statements that threw in the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(garrison_db_errors_total{provider=~"$provider", node=~"$node"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Connections in use
panels.description: Database connections open in the selected processes.

targets.expr: sum(garrison_db_connections_in_use{provider=~"$provider", node=~"$node"}) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Transaction retries
panels.description: Transactions retried after a transient conflict.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(garrison_db_transaction_retries_total{provider=~"$provider", node=~"$node"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Rows pruned
panels.description: Rows removed by retention in the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(garrison_retention_deleted_total[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Statements by operation (per second)
panels.description: Statements per second by operation.

targets.expr: sum by (operation) (rate(garrison_db_operation_duration_seconds_count{provider=~"$provider", table=~"$table", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "operation", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Statements by table (top 15, per second)
panels.description: Busiest tables.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (table) (rate(garrison_db_operation_duration_seconds_count{provider=~"$provider", table=~"$table", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "table", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Statement latency by operation
panels.description: Statement duration percentiles by operation. Exemplar dots open the trace that issued the statement.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, operation) (rate(garrison_db_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{provider=~"$provider", table=~"$table", node=~"$node"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "operation", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, operation) (rate(garrison_db_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{provider=~"$provider", table=~"$table", node=~"$node"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "operation", "none", "", "")

panels.title: p95 by table and operation (top 15)
panels.description: Slowest table and operation pairs.

targets.expr: topk(15, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, table, operation) (rate(garrison_db_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{provider=~"$provider", table=~"$table", node=~"$node"}[$window])))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "operation", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Errors by table and exception
panels.description: Database errors by operation, table, and exception type.

targets.expr: sum by (operation, table, error) (increase(garrison_db_errors_total{provider=~"$provider", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "operation", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Connections in use by node
panels.description: Open connections per process.

targets.expr: sum by (node, provider) (garrison_db_connections_in_use{provider=~"$provider", node=~"$node"}) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "node", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Sqlite write lock wait p95
panels.description: Time waiting for the Sqlite write lock (Sqlite only).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, node) (rate(garrison_db_write_lock_wait_seconds_bucket{provider=~"$provider", node=~"$node"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "node", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Transaction retries
panels.description: Transactions retried after a serialization failure or busy database.

targets.expr: sum by (provider) (increase(garrison_db_transaction_retries_total{provider=~"$provider", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "provider", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Postgresql pool connections (Npgsql)
panels.description: Npgsql connection pool usage by state; empty on Sqlite.

targets.expr: sum by (state) ({__name__=~"db_client_connections?_(usage|count)", node=~"$node"}) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "state", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Postgresql pool wait (Npgsql)
panels.description: Time to acquire a pooled connection, 95th percentile; empty on Sqlite.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate({__name__=~"db_client_connections?_(wait|create)_time.*_bucket", node=~"$node"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Rows pruned by kind
panels.description: Rows removed by retention (runs, run events, request history, audit, sessions, nonces, ...).

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (increase(garrison_retention_deleted_total[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "kind", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Request history capture
panels.description: Request history entries written, dropped (queue full), or failed.

targets.expr: sum by (result) (increase(garrison_request_history_captured_total[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "result", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Archived records
panels.description: Runs and events written to the retention archive, by kind and result.

targets.expr: sum by (kind, result) (increase(garrison_archive_runs_total[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "kind", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Slow database spans
panels.description: Database statement spans (inside request and background traces).
